summary: Desktop bug report from the forum reporter (NewChirp 1.0.54, MX Linux liquorix kernel, /dev/ttyUSB0): three reads, each 'No response from radio'; trace 'AL~WHO | response complete | 0.01s'. The 10 ms reply was the single-wire cable echo, so the port opened and the cable echoes, but the radio never answered (stock driver sends no AL~ wake). Trace now distinguishes echo-only from a radio reply and labels EEPDL addresses correctly.
